title: Route withdrawn by a dormant policy gate
context: A DNS edge provider introduced a per-zone export community change during a normal networking rollout. One route-policy release interprets no-export as a hard suppression; an older release ignores it. No unspecified routing failover exists beyond needs_any links shown. Route nodes represent BGP advertisements, not servers.
semantics: A route-ZONE node is locally down if export_enabled is false, OR if policy_version >= 2 AND community belongs to blocked_communities. Version 1 ignores blocked_communities, but still honors export_enabled. Otherwise it advertises successfully. Consumers use only their listed dependencies. All links are exact and the blocked list is case sensitive.

hypotheses.description: EU export is suppressed by policy version 2 and the new blocked community.
Any no-export community suppresses every version in every zone.
The APAC route is down due to version 2.
The EU DNS service has a CPU bottleneck unrelated to routes.

actions.meaning: Replace the EU blocked community with an allowed community

provenance: Inspired by the 2025-07-14 Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 routing incident; actual addresses, configuration, topology and data are fabricated.
